_comment: Hand-authored fixture for the CDict vocabulary type. Mirrors the layout juliac would emit for `struct CDict{V}; length::Int64; keys::Ptr{Ptr{UInt8}}; values::Ptr{V}; end` (JLWInterop, commit df908fa) instantiated at V=Float64, with one @ccallable function borrowing a CDict{Float64} argument and one returning an owned one, plus the macro-emitted `jlw_free`/`jlw_free_strings` release entrypoints (JLWInterop, commit 3d84973) so the owning return is `:auto`, not `:mechanical`. Field offsets (0, 8, 16, size 24) match design/spike-notes.md's `CDict{Float64}` probe JSON verbatim (no padding needed — all three fields are already 8-byte aligned in declaration order). The Python emitter must recognize the CDict shape (name + full 3-field shape: `length`/`keys`/`values`, `keys` a `Ptr{Ptr{UInt8}}` chain, `values` a pointer to a primitive in `pytypes`) and emit from_dict/as_dict helpers plus an owning-return convert-then-free-twice façade wrapper (jlw_free_strings for keys, then jlw_free for values).
